posts.title: Pseudo-relevances with Jev
posts.description: Pseudo-relevances with Jev The world is abuzz with excitement at the new "system one" models being pumped out right now. In this post, I take a look at how good these models are at generating relevancy scores on the TREC {0, 1, 2, 3} scale. The code used to create the results in this blog can be found here .
